name: Termobeton
description: Termo-beton doo is a company for construction, trade and services founded on April 17, 1996.in Breza. The founders of the company are Frljak Sabit,Bachelor of Civil Engineering and Turbo Ahmed, Bachelor of Civil Engineering.
The Company`s main activity is construction (civil and building construction), production of concrete and precast concrete products, as well as reinforced concrete structures.

detail_timeline.title: Discovery & Planning
detail_timeline.description: We start by understanding your business, users, and objectives. Through research, interviews, and strategy sessions, we define the project scope, goals, and key features.

detail_timeline.title: Design & Prototyping
detail_timeline.description: Next, we translate ideas into visuals. Wireframes evolve into high-fidelity UI designs and clickable prototypes. You’ll be part of the feedback loop at every step.

detail_timeline.title: Development & Testing
detail_timeline.description: Our developers bring the design to life with clean, scalable code — responsive, accessible, and optimized for performance. We run continuous tests to ensure quality.

detail_timeline.title: Launch & Handover
detail_timeline.description: Once everything is tested and approved, we go live! We also provide documentation, training (if needed), and post-launch support to ensure a smooth transition.t

name: Komerce
description: Komerce is a leading tech-startup company in Central Java, Indonesia. The company have a role to become end-to-end e-commerce enabler for Indonesian SMEs. Starting with a product as platform that collaborating SMEs and village youth that we have trained in e-commerce field to co-optimize business on internet.
Komerce already funded by Achmad Zaky Foundation (Zaky is a founder of Bukalapak) & Indigo (Telkom Indonesia's arm for startup acceleration). We are now open & ongoing for the next fundraising stage.
